name: Celebrity Profile / Glossy Entertainment Magazine
visual_language: Premium entertainment publication: cream pages, large serif type, full-bleed and cut-out portraits at different scales, gold and red accents, pull quotes, achievement counters, career timeline.
image_strategy: Many different real photographs of the subject across eras, red-carpet and performance images with a recorded licence, clean cut-outs where they improve the layout. Never one portrait repeated through the video.
composition_rules: the subject is the star in every scene
vary scale: full-bleed, circle crop, cut-out over type
at least one achievement or milestone graphic
photo dates are shown when they show a career progression
transitions: smooth image fades and slides, a ribbon sweep for the record
motion: slow push on full-bleed photos, counters that climb, stars that light in turn
evidence_requirements: every photograph has a recorded source, author and licence, and is credited on screen
facts come from a fetched report
photo dates are the Commons record dates

music.direction: premium, celebratory, energetic without hiding the voice

qa_checks: the subject is recognisable and well photographed
